q: The air flow moving above the top curved surface of the wing has a longer distance to travel and needs to go ____ to have the same transit time as the air travelling along the lower flat surface.
e: The blank is faster. That word is the one that completes the idea about air flow moving above top curved.

q: This causes a low pressure above the wing and a high pressure below the wing which provides a ____ on the wing.
e: This causes a low pressure above the wing and a high pressure below the wing which provides a lift on the wing. Faster air over a wing lowers pressure there and the difference is lift.

q: When the piston of the sprayer is pressed, the fast moving air causes a ____ pressure at the tip of the nozzle.
e: When the piston of the sprayer is pressed, the fast moving air causes a low pressure at the tip of the nozzle. Bernoulli: high speed goes with low pressure.

q: The liquid inside the container is at a ____ pressure, and therefore rushes up through the stem and out the nozzle.
e: The liquid inside the container is at a higher pressure, and therefore rushes up through the stem and out the nozzle. The still fluid sits at higher pressure than the fast stream.

q: The ____ effect is a particular manifestation of Bernoulli's theorem that is commonly associated with a spinning object moving through a fluid.
e: The Magnus effect is a particular manifestation of Bernoulli's theorem that is commonly associated with a spinning object moving through a fluid. Bernoulli's equation keeps p + ½ρv² + ρgh constant along a streamline for incompressible, non-viscous laminar flow.

q: In the case of a ball spinning through the air, the turning ball drags some of the ____ around with it.
e: In the case of a ball spinning through the air, the turning ball drags some of the air around with it. air is the word that belongs in that blank.

q: The effect is named after the German physicist ____, who described the effect in 1852.
e: The effect is named after the German physicist Heinrich Gustav Magnus, who described the effect in 1852. Heinrich Gustav Magnus is the word that belongs in that blank.

q: During cyclones, moving air gain speed above the roof of a house causing the ____ pressure on the roof.
e: During cyclones, moving air gain speed above the roof of a house causing the reduced pressure on the roof. reduced is the word that belongs in that blank.

q: Therefore the pressure inside the house is ____, which can raise the roof.
e: Therefore the pressure inside the house is greater, which can raise the roof. greater is the word that belongs in that blank.
